title: A Peasant’s Life - NEW GAME
author: Fuzzy-Cucumber5776
selftext:
Hello everyone! I made the game so that each story arc takes up one day in a different location. Depending on your choices, you can lose health and money, or recover and earn something. Each arc can end in different ways, and a wrong decision can get you killed.

That’s where the difficulty comes from: you have to think about your decisions because you carry the consequences into the next day. You might survive an encounter but leave with barely any health or money for food.

There are also 10 mini-games throughout the story. The overall goal is to make it through all ten days alive.

My game combines a visual novel with adventure and survival elements. Each story arc takes place in a different location and lasts one day.

**About how I made it:** I used AI to create the visual assets and music, thats all. I wrote the story and designed the gameplay rules, choices, and consequences myself.

The complete ten-day campaign is available now in **beta**, with **four difficulty levels**. It’s playable from start to finish, but bugs and rough edges may still exist.

You can play in English, Russian, Simplified Chinese, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, or French.

This is my indie project, and I’d appreciate people taking a look and sharing their experience.
